<!--
PR title MUST be a Conventional Commit, e.g. `feat(engine): add exact match mode`.
With squash merge the title becomes the commit and the changelog entry (release-please).
Types: feat, fix, perf, refactor, docs, test, build, ci, chore, revert, style. Subject starts lowercase.
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this change and why? Link the issue: Closes #123 -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new feature (minor release)
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix (patch release)
- [ ] `perf`: performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor`: code change without behaviour change
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci`: build system, Docker or workflows
- [ ] `chore`: maintenance, dependencies
- [ ] `revert`: reverts a previous change

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a valid Conventional Commit
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] Docs updated (`CHANGELOG.md` is generated by release-please, do not edit it)
- [ ] No secrets/tokens/personal data included
- [ ] Inputs validated with Zod; mutations call `requireUser()`
- [ ] UI: keyboard, 320px width and dark mode checked
- [ ] Migration generated (if schema changed) and RLS enabled for new tables
